description: Waits for a window of an upstream asset's partitions (categorical or time-based), then triggers a downstream job -- Airflow 3.3's RollupMapper/FanOutMapper + Day/Week/MonthWindow/SegmentWindow + WaitForAll/MinimumCount.

outputs.description: Fires RunRequest(s) for the downstream job once the configured window/wait condition is satisfied.

upstream_asset_key.description: Asset key (slash-delimited) being watched for partition materializations.
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

job_name.description: Name of the downstream job to trigger.
job_name.label: Job Name

mode.description: 'rollup' (Airflow RollupMapper, N upstream partitions -> 1 downstream run). 'fan_out' (Airflow FanOutMapper, 1 upstream partition -> N downstream runs).
mode.label: Mode

window_type.description: 'segment': an explicit categorical key list (Airflow SegmentWindow). 'day'/'week'/'month': a time-based window (Airflow Day/Week/MonthWindow).
window_type.label: Window Type

segment_keys.label: Segment Keys
segment_keys.description: window_type='segment' only (required then): the explicit, fixed set of upstream partition keys that make up one segment (e.g. ['us', 'eu', 'apac']).

upstream_key_format.label: Upstream Key Format
upstream_key_format.description: window_type in ('day','week','month') only: strptime format of the upstream asset's own partition keys.

downstream_key_format.label: Downstream Key Format
downstream_key_format.description: window_type in ('day','week','month') only: strftime format for the rolled-up (mode='rollup') or fanned-out (mode='fan_out') downstream key(s).

wait_policy.label: Wait Policy
wait_policy.description: mode='rollup' only: 'all' (Airflow WaitForAll, the default) requires every expected key in the window; 'minimum_count' (Airflow MinimumCount(n)) fires once `minimum_count` of them have arrived.

max_downstream_keys.label: Max Downstream Keys
max_downstream_keys.description: mode='fan_out', window_type in ('day','week','month') only (required then): how many downstream keys to fan out to (Airflow's max_downstream_keys, e.g. 7 for a week of daily runs).

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: mode='fan_out', window_type in ('day','week','month') only: 'forward' (Airflow Window.Direction.FORWARD, the default) fans out to keys AT AND AFTER the upstream key's anchor; 'backward' fans out to keys ENDING AT it.
